title: Pinpoint integration (ATS & HRMS) | Xobin
text:
About Pinpoint
Pinpoint is a flexible applicant tracking system built for in-house talent teams. It covers careers sites, hiring workflows, automation and reporting, with configurable stages, tags and custom fields.
Why integrate Pinpoint with Xobin?
Integrating Pinpoint with Xobin combines Pinpoint's applicant tracking with Xobin's advanced skill assessments. Recruiters can automate candidate assessments, track progress in real time and view detailed performance reports inside Pinpoint. You save time, eliminate manual work and make smarter hiring decisions based on demonstrated skill.
Steps to Integrate Pinpoint with Xobin
Configure the Xobin Assessment stage in Pinpoint
Log in to Pinpoint and go to
Settings > Templates > Hiring Workflows
Edit an existing workflow or click
+ Create New
Name the workflow something identifiable, for example "Xobin Assessment Workflow".
Add a new stage named exactly
Xobin Assessment
(this naming is mandatory).
Create assessment qualification tags
Go to
Settings > Tag Management
Click
+ New Tag Category
and name it
(mandatory naming).
Under this category create two tags:
Assessment: Passed
and
Assessment: Failed
Enable the Pinpoint API and generate a key
Settings > Integrations > Apps > Pinpoint API
ADD
, then
Name the key (for example "Xobin Assessment") and enable these scopes:
Application: Read, Write
Custom Attributes: Read, Write, Delete
Custom Fields: Read, Write, Delete
Job: Read
Create API Key
and copy it.
Add the API key to Xobin and generate the webhook
In Xobin go to
Settings > Integrations > Pinpoint
Click the arrow to expand, then
Edit
Paste the API key and enter your Pinpoint subdomain, for example yourcompany.pinpointhq.com.
A webhook URL is generated. Copy it.
Register the webhook in Pinpoint
Navigate to
Company > Profile > Webhooks
+ New Webhook
and paste the webhook URL from Xobin.
Enable the event
Application stage changed
Create Webhook
Verify custom fields in Pinpoint
Settings > Custom Fields > Job/Application
and confirm these fields exist:
Job custom field:
Xobin Assessment (dropdown to select the assessment when creating a job post).
Application custom fields:
Assessment Name, Assessment Status, Assessment ID, Qualification, Assessment Report Link, Completed Time, Integrity Score, Overall Score.
Trigger the assessment invite
Move a candidate to the
stage in Pinpoint.
This fires the webhook and sends the assessment invitation automatically.
Review assessment reports
After completion the custom fields on the application are updated with results.
tag is added automatically.
Click the report link for a detailed breakdown of performance.
Who is this integration for?
The Pinpoint and Xobin integration is ideal for recruiters, HR professionals and hiring managers who want to simplify and strengthen hiring. It is especially useful for organisations adding skills-based assessment to their workflow while keeping everything centralised in Pinpoint, automating assessments, evaluating candidates more effectively and making informed decisions without leaving the ATS.
Capabilities
Features & benefits
Webhook-driven invites
The Application stage changed webhook fires the assessment as soon as a candidate reaches the Xobin Assessment stage.
Automatic pass or fail tags
Results add an Assessment: Passed or Assessment: Failed tag from the Xobin Assessment tag category.
Results in custom fields
Assessment name, status, qualification, completed time, integrity score, overall score and the report link populate on the application.
Per-job assessment selection
A Xobin Assessment dropdown on the job post lets you choose the right test when creating each role.
Bulk-progress qualified candidates
Pass and fail tags let you filter applications and move the right people forward in one action.
Full report a click away
The report link on the application opens Xobin's skill-by-skill breakdown for that candidate.
